text: The world here feels curated and intentional—full of glass, screens, and careful design. It is as if I have stepped into a liminal space between past and future: a gallery of innovation, possibility, and human ambition. I am excited to witness the merging of research, technology, and creativity. There is curiosity in my step, a gentle sense of reverence for the effort and thought that has shaped this environment. Yet too, I feel small—a single observer amid the collective pursuit of knowledge and progress.
